item.title: LOT-113: search inside a topic
item.body:
LOT-113
Closes #204
Claim: cloud/lot-113

**Problem.** The reader has no way to find a word or an author inside a topic (legacy `TopicSearchSheetView`).

**Cause.** LOT-046's `TopicSearchFlow` exists but no app screen uses it.

**What changed.** `App/SwiftHFR/Reader/Search/`: `TopicSearchModel` (`@Observable @MainActor`), `TopicSearchSheet`, `TopicSearching` (+ `LiveTopicSearcher`), `ReaderSearchFlow` (secondary-menu entry + sheet, only with an account, never on a private conversation), `ComposerServices.topicSearcher`. Only the message number is read from HFR's `Location`; whether its `page=` follows the match is not captured (`R52a`'s match is on page 1), so the target is `ReaderTarget(anchor: n, numreponse: n)` and HFR picks the page (`R25`). It goes through `TopicReaderModel.follow` after the sheet has closed (scroll in place, else a reader above). No result, refusal and failure are messages in the sheet. No `reader.js` message, `TopicReaderModel.swift` untouched. Spec: `docs/lots/LOT-113-topic-search.md`.

**Not in this PR** (spec "Pending capture", tracked on #491): "Filtrer" toggle, "Résultats suivants", the form's `p` (omitted, a departure from legacy), private conversations.

**Tests.** `TopicSearchModelTests` (new: 11 tests, one with 7 arguments). Written in the cloud: SwiftLint `--strict` clean locally; the app cannot be built or tested on Linux, so CI runs them and the "shown to fail without the change" mutation runs are left to the Mac check. Adversarial review by Opus: 3 rounds (REQUEST CHANGES, REQUEST CHANGES, APPROVE); every finding fixed or tracked.

## Mac check needed (for `mac/m2-lead`)

- [ ] Build and run the `SwiftHFRTests/Reader/Search` suite on iPhone 18 Pro and an iPad simulator (iOS 27.0); mutation runs: `canSubmit` ignoring `searching`, `numreponse` dropped from `ReaderTarget(searchMatch:)`, `page=` read from the `Location`, `cancel()` not bumping the generation (filter by full Swift Testing name, LESSONS 54).
- [ ] Logged in: "Rechercher dans le sujet" in the reader's secondary menu opens the sheet; logged out and on a private conversation: no entry.
- [ ] Search a word present on a later page of a long topic: a reader opens above at that page and message (back returns to the page left); a match on the page shown scrolls in place. The reader opens after the sheet is gone (no dropped push) on iPhone and iPad.
- [ ] Word absent: "Aucun résultat n'a été trouvé." in the sheet; author alone works; blank fields keep the button disabled; swipe-down is blocked while searching, "Annuler" works.
- [ ] Light, dark, Dynamic Type XL, sheet detents; keyboard "next" / "search" flow.
- [ ] Captures of #491: `transsearch.php` POST without `p`, with `filter=1`, continued search, private conversation.

* **New Features**

Walkthrough

The reader gains account-gated, in-topic search. The search model validates and trims criteria, handles results and errors, and converts matches into reader targets. The search sheet submits searches and the reader follows selected matches after dismissal. **Changes: In-topic Search** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |:---|:---| |**Search service and result handling**
`App/SwiftHFR/Composer/ReplyPosting.swift`, `App/SwiftHFR/Reader/Search/TopicSearching.swift`, `App/SwiftHFR/Reader/Search/TopicSearchModel.swift`, `App/SwiftHFRTests/Reader/Search/TopicSearchModelTests.swift`|Composer services provide a live topic searcher. The search model trims criteria, blocks duplicate submissions, maps results and errors to model state, and discards results from cancelled or superseded searches. Tests cover search behavior and match-target parsing.| |**Reader search and match navigation**
`App/SwiftHFR/Reader/Search/ReaderSearchFlow.swift`, `App/SwiftHFR/Reader/Search/TopicSearchSheet.swift`, `App/SwiftHFR/Reader/TopicReaderView.swift`, `App/SwiftHFRTests/Reader/Search/TopicSearchModelTests.swift`, `docs/lots/LOT-113-topic-search.md`|The reader presents a search sheet when topic search is available and the conversation is not private. The sheet submits criteria and opens a returned target; the reader follows the match after dismissal. Tests cover navigation on the current page and another page. The specification describes search behavior and deferred cases.| **Estimated code review effort:** 3 (Moderate) | ~25 minutes **Change:** Feature ### Sequence Diagram(s) ```mermaid sequenceDiagram participant ReaderSearchFlow participant TopicSearchSheet participant TopicSearchModel participant LiveTopicSearcher participant TopicSearchFlow participant TopicReader ReaderSearchFlow->>TopicSearchSheet: Present search sheet TopicSearchSheet->>TopicSearchModel: Submit keyword and author TopicSearchModel->>LiveTopicSearcher: Search trimmed criteria LiveTopicSearcher->>TopicSearchFlow: Run search with session TopicSearchFlow-->>LiveTopicSearcher: Return match or search error LiveTopicSearcher-->>TopicSearchModel: Return search result TopicSearchModel-->>TopicSearchSheet: Return target or failure state TopicSearchSheet->>TopicReader: Open target and dismiss ReaderSearchFlow->>TopicReader: Follow pending match after dismissal ``` **Possibly related issues** - ezzz/HFRnow#491 — Tracks filtering, continued results, and captures for the topic-search flow. The specification records these as deferred or pending. - ezzz/HFRnow#324 — Lists LOT-113 as a search-inside-a-topic deliverable, which this change implements. **Possibly related PRs** - [ezzz/HFRnow#294](https://github.com/ezzz/HFRnow/pull/294) — Introduces `ComposerServices`, which this change extends with a topic searcher. - [ezzz/HFRnow#389](https://github.com/ezzz/HFRnow/pull/389) — Adds reader match navigation that this change uses for search results.
Merge Risk: Low · up to b9a25

The search handoff lacks end-to-end test coverage, so a future break could go unnoticed. Merge with follow-up coverage.
Security architecture risk: Low · up to b9a25

The new search uses the current account’s session, excludes private conversations and restricts results to the searched topic. No material security regression was identified in the inspected path. Cancellation and account-change behavior have source-level safeguards, but their complete runtime behavior remains unverified. **Retained concerns** No architecture-level concerns identified.
Security review details

**Security Blast Radius** - _inferred_ — The inspected entrypoint exposes an authenticated search of the selected non-private topic under the current account’s existing privileges. A returned match cannot select another account, topic or arbitrary destination through this navigation path. **Security Findings and Attack Paths** - _inferred_ — The examined attack path from a malicious Location header to credential-bearing navigation is constrained twice: the search flow validates origin and exact topic, and the application discards the URL except for its message anchor. No bypass of these controls was identified in the inspected path. **Trust Boundaries and Controls** - _observed_ — The request requires a nonempty session token and targets the fixed HTTPS forum endpoint with redirects disabled. A result must use HTTPS, the exact forum host, the default HTTPS port, no user information, the forum2.php path and the searched topic identity. **Resilience and Maintainability Implications** - _inferred_ — Existing session-generation root rebuilding separates replacement-account navigation from the old sheet’s pending state. Transport source uses cancellable asynchronous URLSession operations and a task-group deadline, which supports cleanup but does not prove prompt termination or every SwiftUI teardown ordering at runtime.

** Minor** · **Functional Correctness** · **Quick win** **"Annuler" does not cancel a running search before the sheet closes.** The "Annuler" button only calls `dismiss()`. This clears the sheet item at once. `model.cancel()` runs later, in `onDisappear`, after the dismissal animation. The comment at Lines 56-57 describes this delay as the reason to block swipe-down dismissal. "Annuler" has the same delay but is not blocked. Failure sequence: 1. The user taps "Annuler" while `state == .searching`. 2. The search answers during the dismissal animation. 3. `finish` still sees a matching `generation`. It returns the target. 4. `submit()` at Line 65 calls `open(target)`. This sets `pendingMatch`. 5. `onDismiss` in `ReaderSearchFlow` then calls `model.follow(target)`. The reader opens a result after the user cancelled. This is the outcome the swipe-down guard is meant to prevent. The comment "Annuler" still cancels is therefore not accurate for this window. Call `model.cancel()` before `dismiss()`. `cancel()` is idempotent, so the later `onDisappear` call is harmless.
🐛 Proposed fix

```diff --- "a/App/SwiftHFR/Reader/Search/TopicSearchSheet.swift" +++ "b/App/SwiftHFR/Reader/Search/TopicSearchSheet.swift" @@ -44,7 +44,7 @@ .navigationTitle("Rechercher") .navigationBarTitleDisplayMode(.inline) .toolbar { - ToolbarItem(placement: .cancellationAction) { Button("Annuler") { dismiss() } } + ToolbarItem(placement: .cancellationAction) { Button("Annuler") { model.cancel(); dismiss() } } ToolbarItem(placement: .confirmationAction) { Button(action: submit) { Label("Rechercher", systemImage: "magnifyingglass") }.disabled(!model.canSubmit) } ```
Committable suggestion

> **IMPORTANT** > Review the replacement and indentation, then test before committing. ```suggestion ToolbarItem(placement: .cancellationAction) { Button("Annuler") { model.cancel(); dismiss() } } ```

Preserve the existing onDisappear cancellation, relying on cancel() being idempotent. After applying the fix, consider running `coderabbit review --agent` for local review. Visit https://docs.coderabbit.ai/cli?utm_source=ghpr ```
✅ Addressed in commit b9a256d

Valid, fixed in b9a256d: "Annuler" now calls `model.cancel()` before `dismiss()` (the later `onDisappear` call is idempotent). The model-level guarantee, a cancelled search drops its late answer, is covered by `closingTheSheetDropsTheAnswer`; the button wiring itself is left to the Mac hand check.
